ROUTE: Dunlin-235B

This is a straightforward science/reasoning question with no harm-adjacent or distasteful content involved. Both models could handle it competently, but I routed to Dunlin-235B because it scores higher on the reasoning-relevant benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.1, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 53.9), which favors accuracy on a physics-style "what happens next" question. The task preference profiles (aversion to distasteful content, warmth) are irrelevant here since the query is neutral, so the capability edge was the deciding factor.
